components.source: Filing accession 0001901612-26-000020, Schedule of Investments, table 30 row 26: Total investments; fair value 2,483,694 (in thousands)

evidence.quote: Schedule of Investments, table 30 row 26: Total investments | $ | 2,489,435 | 204.9 | % | $ | 2,483,694 (amounts in thousands; final amount is fair value).
Consolidated Statement of Assets and Liabilities, table 4 row 20: Total Assets | $ | 2,566,283 (amounts in thousands) at March 31, 2026.
fund_financials for report_date 2026-03-31 reports investments_at_fair_value 2483694000.0 and total_assets 2566283000.0.

rationale: The filing presents a single final Total investments row whose fair-value column is 2,483,694 thousand, or 2,483,694,000. This exactly matches the companyfacts investments-at-fair-value tag, indicating that the tag captured the complete investment total rather than a partial affiliated or non-affiliated schedule. The result is 96.8% of total assets and leaves 82,589,000 of non-investment assets, a plausible balance-sheet remainder for this BDC. Money market funds are separately presented after Total investments and therefore are not included in the requested investments-at-fair-value total.
